svg.title: Hinge: muscles trained and joint angles
svg.desc: Posterior view from the lower back to the feet with the hamstrings, gluteus maximus and erector spinae highlighted, the hip and knee lines marked, and a side column showing the start and end position, joint angle curves and muscle action timing.
svg.text: Hip and knee curves are schematic; the trunk curve tracks forward lean.
Base figure: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology, figure 11.5. Labels removed, cropped. CC BY 4.0.
